name: Touma Kikuna
source:
Kanako's mother. After her husband's death, she has been taking care of the house as the head of the family.
When her daughter gets pregnant, she tries to break them up for a while, but Kanako's stubbornness and Hiroki's sincerity make her approve (or rather order) their marriage and allows them to live together as a couple.

At first glance, she appears intelligent and arrogant, but in reality, she is still a sheltered woman, not so different from Kanako, and her strong desire to "protect the house and her daughter" leads her to believe that she must take care of Hiroki's desires.

[Translated from the [url=http://cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/haramari/character.html]official website[/url]]
